Rounds
Keyboard: arrows / WASD move · SPACE drop / throw bomb · J action (kick / punch / carry) · K remote detonate. Touch controls are available during play.
Walk into bombs to kick them if you have Kick. Punch launches bombs multiple tiles. Line drops a row of bombs. Carry lets you pick up a bomb with ACT, then throw it with BOMB.
